name: Knockdown currency
citation: library/mk2/arcade.frames.json: reptile/slide -> damage 13, knockdown 1, on_block -12, on_hit NULL (a knockdown has no on-hit advantage: docs/frames.md 1.1). reptile/HP/far -> on_hit +4, on_block +13, damage 11.
claim: Reptile's slide knocks Mileena down for 13. What the knockdown actually buys is measured, not assumed: he can walk again at f53, she at f68, and she lands 160 px away. Fifteen frames and a walk -- enough to re-establish jab range and meet her rising with pressure, NOT enough for a meaty.

beats.name: slide-hits-knockdown
beats.note: slide = back + LK+LP+Block, one 8-frame chord (the profile's own encoding). Contact f11, 13 damage. Knockdown verified on the VICTIM'S OWN y leaving its resting value (87 -> apex 42 -> 87), frames 12-41; docs/frames.md 10 forbids a scalar GROUND_Y.

beats.name: the-wakeup-clock
beats.note: Wakeup clock, measured differentially (hold a direction from well before actionability; first frame x diverges from the no-input control, 3 reps identical): Reptile f53, Mileena f68 -- the knockdown is worth +15 frames at a 160 px gap. He spends all of it closing 160 px -> 77 px; she holds Block from f59 and rises into guard at f68.

beats.name: jab-pressure-resumes
beats.note: Two far HPs, both blocked (3 chip each, 11 would be a hit), 19 frames apart -- Reptile's own +13-on-block jab loop, the sequence-1 pattern handed to the other side. The knockdown's currency was the APPROACH.

notes: Rung: m-gap-25 (gap_px 114). Slide travel is a step function of gap (it stops on contact) -- mk2.md; this sequence is pinned to one rung and nothing is interpolated.
refusals: The brief's okizeme beat -- 'the attacker is standing over Mileena on wakeup with jab pressure resuming' -- is REFUSED as a MEATY. Reason: the slide launches the victim to a 160 px gap (measured identically from 4 rungs), Reptile's longest connect range is 110 px, and he can walk again at f53 against her wakeup at f68. Fifteen free frames cannot cover the 83 px of approach (~2.5 px/frame), so the earliest he can threaten her is f97 -- 29 frames AFTER she is actionable. What the knockdown really buys is the free approach, and that is what the beats claim.
